content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: PayLink: Automated PayLink with Opportunities ## slug: payments-use-cases-paylink-automated-opportunities ## seoTitle: PayLink: Automated PayLink with Opportunities ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End ## Scenario A common use case is that a salesperson will close an {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} and send the customer a link to the payment request. To do this, you can build three things without using code. - A {{variable.ProcessBuilder}} process to automatically create a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} record when the {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} {{variable.Field_Opportunity_Stage}} = {{variable.Picklist_Opp_Stage_ClosedWon}}. - A {{variable.ProcessBuilder}} process to automatically roll-up the {{variable.Product_PayLink}} on to the {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} record. - A {{variable.Setup_WorkflowRule}} with an Email Alert to automatically email the {{variable.Product_PayLink}} to the customer. ## Instructions ### Step One 1. Create a custom URL type field on the {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} object called {{variable.Field_Opportunity_PayLink}}. 2. Create a lookup type field on the {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} object called {{variable.Field_Opportuni_BillingContact}} that looks to the {{variable.Object_Contact}} object and is filtered by the {{variable.Object_Account}} record on the {{variable.Object_Opportunity}}. This is for sending a Workflow email all from one object ({{variable.Object_Opportunity}}). 3. Alternatively, roll-up a related {{variable.Object_OpportunityContactRole}} record from the {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} to populate this value too. ![G_01_03 instructions pic 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/G_01_03%20instructions%20pic%201.png){height="" width=""} ### Step Two *Auto-create the Blackthorn {{variable.Product_Payments}} {{variable.Object_Transaction}} from the {{variable.Picklist_Opp_Stage_ClosedWon}} {{variable.Object_Opportunity}}.* 1. Create a new {{variable.ProcessBuilder}}. 2. Set {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_ProcStartWh}} to "A record changes". 3. Click **+ Add Object**. 4. Type in "Opportunity", and select "when a record is created or edited". 5. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 6. Click **+ Add Criteria**. 7. Enter a {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_CriteriName}} and select "Conditions are met" for {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_CritExecAct}}. 8. Under {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_Field}}, find the {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} {{variable.Field_Opportunity_Stage}}, set {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_Operator}} to "Equals", and pick {{variable.Picklist_Opp_Stage_ClosedWon}} for the {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_Value}}. 9. Under IMMEDIATE ACTIONS, click **+ Add Action**. 10. {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_ActionType}} = "Create a Record" 11. Ender an {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_ActionName}} and set {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_RecordType}} to "Transaction". 12. Under Set Field Values, enter the following information. | Field | Type | Value | | --- | --- | --- | | Amount | Formula | [Opportunity].Amount | | Opportunity | Field Reference | [Opportunity].Id | | Description | Formula | [Opportunity].Description | | Due Date | Formula | [Opportunity].CloseDate | | Contact | Field Reference | [Opportunity].Billing_Contact | 13. Activate the {{variable.ProcessBuilder}}. As an alternative to the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Contact}} field, you can populate the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Account}} lookup field on the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object with the {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} {{variable.Field_Opportunity_AccountName}} field. However, if you want both lookup fields on the {{variable.Object_Transaction}}, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Account}} lookup will supersede the {{variable.Field_Opportunity_AccountName}} lookup when viewing the {{variable.Product_PayLink}} form. ![G_01_03 instructions pic 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/G_01_03%20instructions%20pic%202.png){height="" width=""} ### Step Three *Auto roll-up the {{variable.Product_PayLink}} from {{variable.Object_Transaction}} to {{variable.Object_Opportunity}}. This will allow you to use the {{variable.Product_PayLink}} in the Email Alert.* 1. Create a new {{variable.ProcessBuilder}}. 2. Set {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_ProcStartWh}} to "A record changes". 3. Click **+ Add Object**, type in "Transaction", and select "only when a record is created". 4. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 5. Click **+ Add Criteria**, name your criteria and select " Conditions are met". 6. Under field, find {{variable.Object_Transaction}} {{variable.Field_Transaction_Opportunity}}, set operator to "IS NULL", type to "Boolean" and pick "False" for the value. *This criteria tells the process to only fire when the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} has a related {{variable.Object_Opportunity}}.* 7. Under Immediate Actions, click **+ Add Action**. 8. {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_ActionType}} = Update Records, enter your {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_ActionName}} and set {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_RecordType}} = "Opportunity". 9. No criteria-just update the records! 10. Field = {{variable.Field_Transaction_PayLink}}; Type = Formula; Value = "[bt_stripe**Transaction**c].bt_paylink**PayLink**c". 11. Activate the {{variable.ProcessBuilder}}. ![G_01_03 instructions pic 3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/G_01_03%20instructions%20pic%203.png){height="" width=""} ### Step Four *Create a {{variable.Setup_WorkflowRule}} with an {{variable.Workflow_EmailAlerts}} to automatically email the {{variable.Product_PayLink}} to the customer.* 1. Create the {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}}. *Here is an example {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}}.* ![G_01_03 instructions pic 4](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/G_01_03%20instructions%20pic%204.png){height="" width=""} 2. Create the {{variable.Setup_WorkflowRule}} and {{variable.Workflow_EmailAlerts}}. This will email your customer when the {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} {{variable.Field_Opportunity_Stage}} = {{variable.Picklist_Opp_Stage_ClosedWon}}, and there is a {{variable.Field_Opportunity_PayLink}} value. *Here is an example {{variable.Setup_WorkflowRule}} and {{variable.Workflow_EmailAlerts}}.* ![G_01_03 instructions pic 5](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/G_01_03%20instructions%20pic%205.png){height="" width=""} *When {{variable.Field_Opportunity_PayLink}} field is not empty and the {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} {{variable.Field_Opportunity_Stage}} = {{variable.Picklist_Opp_Stage_ClosedWon}} then send {{variable.Product_PayLink}} to customer.* ![G_01_03 instructions pic 6](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/G_01_03%20instructions%20pic%206.png){height="" width=""} Boom! Done. ## Additional Use Cases If you have any suggestions for a use case with Blackthorn {{variable.Product_Payments}} please contact {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} and provide details on your use case. We always appreciate hearing the solutions our customers create and love sharing that with our other customers!
